$comment: Hydrogen (#83): `context.storefront.query(document, { variables })` and `mutate` send to the Storefront API of the store `createStorefrontClient({ storeDomain })` (or `createHydrogenContext`) was given, at `{shop}.myshopify.com/api/{version}/graphql.json`; `context.customerAccount.query(...)` to the Customer Account API at `shopify.com/{shopId}/account/customer/api/{version}/graphql`. Route handlers get these clients from the request's context, not from an import: in a project whose manifests declare Hydrogen, a `storefront` or `customerAccount` value's `query` / `mutate` is the client's (`contextClients`); elsewhere the names say nothing (`callersOnly`). #92 adds the cart handler (`createCartHandler`, `context.cart.addLines(lines)`, `updateLines`, `get()`...): Storefront API mutations whose documents the library writes (`document`, the 2025.1 operation names; the cart's fields are the project's fragment, `cart` stays a leaf); the variables the method is given go under their key (`{ lines }`). `addLines` and the other updates create the cart (`cartCreate`) when there is none yet.
